item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00058","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C03","C13","C10"],"selected_candidate_label":"C03","confidence":0.89,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C03 plausibly supplied a concrete transfer-order template: it first transfers specified functions and associated operational assets from one agency to another, then separately transfers the necessary unexpended appropriations under a Bureau of the Budget determination. The child follows substantially the same compact sequence—transfer specified functions, transfer appropriated funds with Budget Director involvement, and arrange transfer of records, property, facilities, and personnel. C13 and C10 contain similar administrative machinery, but their broader reorganizations and more elaborate provisions are less closely aligned with the child's concise structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"All functions ... of the Department of Defense ... with respect to the following are hereby transferred to the National Aeronautics and Space Administration","parent_excerpt":"All functions of administration ... now vested in or exercised by the Secretary of the Army ... are hereby transferred to the American Battle Monuments Commission","explanation":"Both begin by transferring a specifically delimited set of functions from a defense-related department to another federal entity."},{"child_excerpt":"The Secretary of the Treasury shall immediately transfer to the appropriation of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration ... such amounts as shall be determined by the Director of the Bureau of the Budget","parent_excerpt":"There shall be transferred to the American Battle Monuments Commission so much of the unexpended balances of appropriations ... as the Director of the Bureau of the Budget may deem necessary","explanation":"Both use a separate appropriations-transfer provision whose amount is controlled by a Bureau of the Budget determination."},{"child_excerpt":"appropriate transfers of records, property, facilities, and civilian personnel shall be carried out","parent_excerpt":"such supplies, equipment, temporary structures, utilities and facilities ... and ... the cemetery records ... are hereby transferred","explanation":"Both pair the functional transfer with transfer of the operational property, facilities, and records needed to perform the transferred functions."}]}
